item.title: US Overdose Deaths Decline
item.description:
• Summary: U.S. overdose deaths declined again in 2025, continuing a positive trend in the public health crisis and reflecting ongoing efforts in prevention and treatment.

  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: Medicare Hospice Enrollment Halt
item.description:
• Summary: The Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS) has halted the enrollment of new hospice and home health providers, citing concerns over fraud and patient safety. This policy change impacts how new providers enter the Medicare program.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News

item.title: EU Drug Import Reduction Plans
item.description:
• Summary: The European Union has advanced plans to reduce its reliance on drug imports from non-EU countries, aiming to strengthen pharmaceutical supply chain security and domestic manufacturing capabilities.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: Pharmaceutical Technology

item.title: AI Medical Devices FDA Secret
item.description:
• Summary: An investigation reveals that the FDA's process for clearing AI medical devices is opaque and potentially compromised, with a 'dirty secret' involving undisclosed conflicts of interest and inadequate oversight.
  • MoAs: N/A
  • Sources: STAT News
